The '''Unagin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Unagin]].
